notes.title: Patch 2.0
notes.content:
[h2][b]The update data for “TEKKEN 8” will be distributed with the following details:[/b][/h2]

[h3]Ver.2.00.01[/h3]

[h2][u]Application Date and Time[/u][/h2]

[h3][CEST] From around 0:00 AM on Tuesday, April 1st, applied sequentially[/h3]
[h3][PDT] From around 3:00 PM on Monday, March 31st, applied sequentially[/h3]

[h2][u]Maintenance Date and Time[/u][/h2]

[h3][CEST] Monday, March 31st, 11:30 PM – Tuesday, April 1st, 6:00 AM[/h3]
[h3][PDT] Monday, March 31st, 2:30 PM – 9:00 PM[/h3]

[h3]Note:[/h3]
[h3]Please note that the date and time may change without prior notice.[/h3]
[h3]All online content will be unavailable during maintenance.[/h3]

[h2][u]Impact of the Update[/u][/h2]

[h3]The application of the update data will affect the following modes and features:[/h3]

[h3]“DOWNLOADED REPLAYS” / “MY REPLAY & TIPS”[/h3]
[h3]Replay data from before the update will no longer be playable.[/h3]
[h3]“ONLINE REPLAY”[/h3]
[h3]All replay data from before the update will be deleted.[/h3]
[h3]“SUPER GHOST BATTLE” / “GHOST MATCH” / “Ghost vs. Ghost”[/h3]
[h3]The behavior and performance of characters after the update will be reflected in ghost data. There will be no loss of data.[/h3]

[h2][u]The details of the update are as follows:[/u][/h2]

[h2][u]Downloadable Content (Paid DLC)[/u][/h2]

[h3]Playable Character “Anna Williams”[/h3]
[h3]The character “Anna” will be available on each platform store starting from the following dates:[/h3]

[h3][u]1) Early Access[/u][/h3]

[h3][CEST] Tuesday, April 1st at around 1:00 AM[/h3]
[h3][PDT] Monday, March 31st at around 4:00 PM[/h3]

[h3]Note:[/h3]
[h3]Early access (72 hours) is available by purchasing one of the following bundles released on the above date:[/h3]

[h3]For those who own the base game of “TEKKEN 8”:[/h3]
[h3]“TEKKEN 8 Season 2 Character & Stage Pass”[/h3]
[h3]“TEKKEN 8 Season 2 Character Pass”[/h3]

[h3]For those who do not own the base game of “TEKKEN 8”:[/h3]
[h3]“TEKKEN 8 Season 2 Ultimate Edition”[/h3]
[h3]“TEKKEN 8 Season 2 Deluxe Edition”[/h3]

[h3][u]2) General Access[/u][/h3]

[h3][CEST] Friday, April 4th at around 1:00 AM[/h3]
[h3][PDT] Thursday, April 3rd at around 4:00 PM[/h3]

[h3]Note:[/h3]
[h3]General access becomes available by purchasing the “Anna” downloadable content released on the above date.[/h3]

[h2][u]TEKKEN SHOP[/u][/h2]

[h3]Added “TEKKEN FIGHT PASS -ROUND 5-”[/h3]
[h3]Complete missions during the period to level up and earn various items[/h3]
[h3]“PREMIUM” grants more items than “FREE”[/h3]
[h3]“FREE” allows up to 100 TEKKEN COINS to be earned[/h3]
[h3]In addition to the 100 coins from “FREE,” “PREMIUM” grants up to 600 more, for a total of 700 TEKKEN COINS[/h3]

[h3]Added Avatar Skin “Anna”[/h3]
[h3]An avatar skin usable in “TEKKEN FIGHT LOUNGE”[/h3]
[h3]To celebrate Anna’s release, it is available at a limited-time sale price of 75% OFF (100 TEKKEN COINS)[/h3]

[h3]“TEKKEN SPECIAL DEAL” Event Held[/h3]
[h3]Selected items are available at special prices during the event[/h3]

[h2][u]TEKKEN FIGHT LOUNGE[/u][/h2]

[h3]Five Special Ghosts Appearing with Obtainable Character Panels[/h3]
[h3]Talk to and defeat them to obtain one character panel each[/h3]
[h3]Character panels are fan art works submitted through the “TEKKEN FANDOM Campaign”[/h3]
[h3]Special Ghosts will appear in the lobby until the next update scheduled for May[/h3]
[h3]They will be replaced with new Special Ghosts in the next update[/h3]

[h2][u]TEKKEN BALL[/u][/h2]

[h3]Adjusted ball return behavior for certain moves in “TEKKEN BALL” mode[/h3]

[h2][u]RANKED MATCH[/u][/h2]

[h3][b]① Matching has been changed so that players can battle others with a closer skill level[/b][/h3]

[h3]Matchmaking System Changes in Ranked Match[/h3]
[h3]Matchmaking based on “Tekken Prowess” has been removed[/h3]
[h3]Matchmaking now considers the rank of the character currently in use and the player’s highest rank among all used characters[/h3]

[h3]Sub-Character Rank Inheritance System Adjustments[/h3]
[h3]Changed the timing and target rank for sub-character rank inheritance[/h3]
[h3]When the highest reached rank among all characters is updated, rank inheritance will be applied[/h3]

[h3]Search Criteria Changes[/h3]
[h3]Added “Same Rank Only” to Rank Restrictions[/h3]
[h3]Changed “±1 Preferred”, “±2 Preferred”, and “±3 Preferred” to “±1 or lower”, “±2 or lower”, and “±3 or lower”[/h3]
[h3][i]Note: These changes make it less likely to match with opponents whose rank is outside the selected range[/i][/h3]

[h2][u]New Ranks Added Beyond “Destruction God”[/u][/h2]

[h3]Eight new ranks added after “Destruction God”:[/h3]

[h3]God of Destruction I / II / III / IV / V / VI / VII / ∞ (Ouroboros)
[/h3]
[h3][u]Note: The difficulty of ranking up increases significantly in the ranks beyond “Destruction God”[/u][/h3]

[h2][u]Rank Reset Implemented[/u][/h2]

[h3]At the start of Season 2, ranks are determined based on the highest rank achieved in Season 1[/h3]

[h3]Special Titles will be awarded based on the highest rank achieved in Season 1 as part of the rank reset process[/h3]

[h3][b]② The following changes have been made to create a more competitive and satisfying point system[/b][/h3]

[h3]Point Gain/Loss System Adjustments[/h3]

[h3]The higher your opponent’s rank, the more points you earn for a win
The lower your opponent’s rank, the more points you lose for a defeat
[/h3]
(Examples)

[h3][u]1) Lower-Ranked Match[/u][/h3]

[h3]You: “Fujin” (Rank 21) vs Opponent: “Battle Ruler” (Rank 20)
> Win: +720pt / Loss: -1280pt[/h3]

[h3][u]2) Same-Rank Match[/u][/h3]

[h3]You: “Fujin” (Rank 21) vs Opponent: “Fujin” (Rank 21)
> Win: +1000pt / Loss: -1000pt[/h3]

[h3][u]3) Higher-Ranked Match[/u][/h3]

[h3]You: “Fujin” (Rank 21) vs Opponent: “Raijin” (Rank 22)
> Win: +1280pt / Loss: -720pt

Promotion bonus points are now only awarded once upon reaching a new highest rank
The system that caused a significant point drop after 3 consecutive losses has been removed
The win streak bonus system has been adjusted:
- Bonus points for win streaks are now only available up to “Tenryu” (Rank 17)
- For ranks “Tenryu” and below, bonus points start applying after 3 consecutive wins
- For ranks “Tenryu” and below, the more wins in a row, the greater the additional points earned[/h3]

[h2][u]QUICK MATCH[/u][/h2]

[h3]Added “Rank Restriction” Option to Search Criteria[/h3]

[h3]Now possible to choose from:
”Same Rank Only” / “±1 or lower” / “±2 or lower” / “±3 or lower” / “No Restriction”[/h3]

[h2][u]“RANKED MATCH”, “QUICK MATCH”, “VERSUS”, “PLAYER MATCH”[/u][/h2]

[h3]Added “In-Battle Status”[/h3]

[h3]Now displays combo count and combo damage in actual battles, just like in “Practice” mode
To turn the display OFF, go to OPTIONS > “Screen Settings” > “In-Battle Status Settings” > toggle ON/OFF
In “PRACTICE” and “MY REPLAY & TIPS”, you can toggle it from the “Display Settings” in the pause menu[/h3]

[h2][u]PRACTICE[/u][/h2]

[h3]Added a Special Practice-Only Stage[/h3]

[h3]A practice-only stage with a wall distance of approximately 500m is now available
Select “Practice Stage” under “Restart Settings” and press [Touchpad/View button/V] + [×/A/J] (normal restart method) to switch to the practice stage
You can also switch to the practice stage by pressing [Touchpad/View button/V] + [↑]
To return to the original stage after switching with [Touchpad/View button/V] + [↑], press [Touchpad/View button/V] + [×/A/J][/h3]

[h3]New Items Added to the Reversal Move List[/h3]

[h3]The following CPU actions can now be set:
Heat Burst / Heat Burst (Cancel) / Standing Block / Crouching Block /
Low Parry / Dash / Back Dash / Sidestep (Into Background) /
Side Walk (Into Background) / Sidestep (Into Foreground) / Side Walk (Into Foreground)[/h3]

[h2][u]OPTIONS[/u][/h2]

[h3]Added “V-Sync” Setting[/h3]

[h3]“V-Sync” settings are now available on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S
Can be toggled ON/OFF via Options > Graphics Settings > V-Sync[/h3]

[h2][u]LEADERBOARDS[/u][/h2]

[h3]Now Reflects Season 2 Stats[/h3]

[h3]Season 1 leaderboards have been reset
Online ranking data from Season 2 is now viewable[/h3]

[h2][u]“PLAY DATA”[/u][/h2]

[h3]Now Reflects Season 2 Stats[/h3]

[h3]Season 1 stats have been reset in the following categories:
BATTLE (ONLINE), OTHER (ONLINE section only), PLAYSTATS, CHARACTER DATA (ONLINE)
Newly accumulated stats from Season 2 are now displayed[/h3]

[h2][u]Playable Characters[/u][/h2]

[h3]Character Move Behavior Fixes and Balance Adjustments[/h3]

[h3]Please check the article at the following URLs for details on the fixes and adjustments: [url=https://www.tekken-official.jp/tekken_news/?p=942]Link[/url][/h3]

[h2][u]TEKKEN Talk Live Season 2 Special[/u][/h2]

[h3]Covers the main direction of ranked match and battle balance adjustments in “Season 2”[/h3]

[h3]YouTube : [url=https://www.youtube.com/live/xmik3NHJGjI]Link[/url][/h3]

[h2][u]TEKKEN Talk Live Season 2 & Anna Special[/u][/h2]

[h3]Showcases “Season 2” battle balance adjustments and live gameplay of the new character “Anna”[/h3]

[h3] YouTube : [url=https://www.youtube.com/live/Z5G9cCvMfvY]Link[/url][/h3]

[b]Thank you for your continued support of “TEKKEN 8”.[/b]

notes.title: Patch 1.11 🥊
notes.content:
[h1]TEKKEN 8 - Patch 1.11[/h1]

[url=https://bnent.eu/TKN8-Patch111][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43136267/4f2a75fadccb372ff48382d2d37cea883b3a80b0.jpg[/img][/url]

The update data for [b]TEKKEN 8[/b] will be distributed with the following details:
[h2]Version[/h2]
[b]Ver.1.11.00[/b]
[h2]Application Date and Time[/h2]
[list] [][b][JST][/b] From around 11:00 on Wednesday, January 15th, applied sequentially
[][b][CET][/b] From around 3:00 on Wednesday, January 15th, applied sequentially
[*][b][PST][/b] From around 18:00 on Tuesday, January 14th, applied sequentially
[/list]
[h2]Maintenance Date and Time[/h2]
[list] [][b][JST][/b] Wednesday, January 15th, 10:30 – 14:00
[][b][CET][/b] Wednesday, January 15th, 2:30 – 6:00
[*][b][PST][/b] Tuesday, January 14th, 17:30 – 21:00
[/list]
[b]Note:[/b]
Please note that the date and time may change without prior notice.
All online content will be unavailable during maintenance.
[h2]Impact of the Update[/h2]
The application of the update data will affect the following modes and features:
[list] [][b]DOWNLOADED REPLAYS / MY REPLAY & TIPS:[/b] Replay data from before the update will no longer be playable.
[][b]ONLINE REPLAY:[/b] All replay data from before the update will be deleted.
[*][b]SUPER GHOST BATTLE / GHOST MATCH:[/b] The behavior and performance of characters after the update will be reflected in ghost data. There will be no loss of data.
[/list]
[h2]Details of the Update[/h2]
[h2]TEKKEN SHOP[/h2]
[list] [*][b]“Flamboyant Pack” Added:[/b]
Flamboyant Hair (Hair)
Flamboyant Haori & Hakama (Upper Body)
Flamboyant Geta (Shoes)
Flamboyant Peacock Feathers (Accessory)
[*][b]“Sublime Pack” Added:[/b]
Sublime Hair (Hair)
Sublime Long-Sleeve Kimono (Upper Body)
Sublime Geta (Shoes)
Sublime Fan (Accessory)
[*][b]“TEKKEN SPECIAL DEAL” Available:[/b] Selected items available at special prices during the event period.
[/list]
[h2]MAIN MENU[/h2]
[list] [][b]Characters can now be selected from Customized Slots:[/b] Added the ability to select main menu characters from slots other than “PRESET” via [b]OPTIONS > Screen Settings > Main Menu Character Display Settings > Costume[/b].
[][b]Added UI Hide Function:[/b] Press [R3/R Stick/N] to hide the UI.
[/list]
[h2]CHARACTER CUSTOMIZE[/h2]
[list] [*][b]“Shared Customize Slot” Added:[/b]
20 customization slots shared across all playable characters.
Access the shared tab from each character’s dedicated slot screen.
[][b]“Add to Favorites” Function:[/b] Press [□/X button/U] in the customization slot list to add/remove favorites.
[][b]“Replace” Function:[/b] Rearrange customization slots by pressing [△/Y button/I].
[/list]
[h2]QUICK MATCH / GROUP MATCH / TEKKEN BALL (ONLINE)[/h2]
[list] [*][b]Added Rematch Function:[/b] Players can rematch from the result screen after a best-of-3 match without returning to the matchmaking standby screen.
[/list]
[h2]PRACTICE[/h2]
[list] [][b]Improved “Punishment Settings” Display:[/b] Configured CPU behavior settings now displayed in the “Punishment Settings” list.
[][b]Improved Photo Mode Controls:[/b] Mouse wheel can now be used for zoom in/out operations (Steam version only).
[/list]
[h2]OPTIONS[/h2]
[list] [*][b]Hide Other Player Information:[/b]
Configure via [b]Screen Settings > Hide Other Player Names / Hide Friends/Following/Rivals[/b].
Opponent player names in various modes will appear as “-”.
[*][b]Hide Friends/Following/Rivals Displays:[/b] Configurable in lounges, profiles, and match result screens.
[/list]
[h2]REPLAY[/h2]
[list] [*][b]Access Replay List from Profile Screen:[/b] Players can now navigate to a replay list directly from a profile.
[/list]
[h2]PLAYABLE CHARACTERS[/h2]
[list] [*][b]Adjusted Behavior and Performance:[/b] Behavior fixes and performance adjustments have been applied to Heihachi and Clive.
Heihachi received minor adjustments to address unintended phenomena.
Clive underwent significant balance changes, suppressing the performance of certain overpowered moves.
[*][b]Sound and Visual Improvements:[/b] Enhancements were made to sound effects (SE), voice, and visual effects.
[/list]
[h2]BUG FIXES[/h2]
[list] [*][b]Win Streak Display Fixed:[/b] The win streak display in “PLAYER MATCH” session screens now accurately reflects consecutive wins within the same session.
Win streaks in “PLAYER MATCH” will be reset after the update.
[/list]
[h1][b]Thank you for your continued support of TEKKEN 8![/b][/h1]

[h3][b]More details [url=https://bnent.eu/TKN8-Patch111]here[/url] ![/b][/h3]

notes.title: Lidia Sobieska is the second DLC character for TEKKEN 8, more updates revealed
notes.content:
[h2]TEKKEN 8 revealed its roadmap for the months to come, which includes[b] battle adjustments[/b], [b]free additions[/b] and [b]second DLC character[/b], [b]Lidia Sobieska[/b].
[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43136267/f8631a833116b7ed8acd12728e3e015ff6f164cb.png[/img]

[h3]Starting this spring, battle adjustments will be made as [b]the development team continues to work on improving the balance of the game as well as the player experience[/b].

This summer, [b]the first free updates will be out[/b], including the release of a new stage, the Seaside Resort, and introducing the Photo Mode.

In Autumn, a brand-new story, involving Eddy Gordo, will come for free to TEKKEN 8. Additional modes, such as Ghost vs. Ghost or Online Practice are planned to be added at a later date.[/h3]

[previewyoutube=y9Wl6odjv7g;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]Last but not least, the [b]Prime Minister of Poland[/b], [b]Lidia Sobieska[/b], makes [b]her return[/b] in TEKKEN 8. She will be available [b]this summer with an early access[/b] for Character Year 1 Pass owners.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43136267/21cbbab16fef4d9d01f67398dc88a1d1949315cc.png[/img]

[h3]Hot on the heels of EVO Japan, the TEKKEN WORLD TOUR is still underway, as players all across the globe compete to earn points and try to clinch a spot for the [b][url=https://bnent.eu/Tekken-World-Tour]TEKKEN WORLD TOUR Finals[/url][/b]. [/h3]

notes.content:
[h2][b]Update Contents[/b][/h2]
[h3][list]
[*] New playable character ‘EDDY GORDO’ added ([b]early access 04/02[/b])

[*] New feature [b]TEKKEN FIGHT PASS[/b] added to the [b]TEKKEN SHOP
[/b]
[*]New items added to the [b]TEKKEN SHOP[/b]

[*] [b]Feature improvements[/b] and [b]bug fixes[/b]

[*] [b]Properties and/or behavior for select moves of select characters were adjusted[/b].
[/list][/h3]

[previewyoutube=DZV8ygT8pNA;full][/previewyoutube]

[list]
[h2][b]▼ Details as follows:[/b][/h2]

[*]New playable character [b]‘EDDY GORDO’[/b]

[*][b]72-hour early access[/b] made available to owners of the Playable Character Year 1 Pass.

[*]Playable Character Year 1 Pass is included in the following:

[b]「TEKKEN 8 Deluxe Edition Upgrade Pack」
「TEKKEN 8 Ultimate Edition」
「TEKKEN 8 Deluxe Edition」[/b]

[h2]▼ New feature[b] TEKKEN FIGHT PASS[/b] added to the [b]TEKKEN SHOP[/b][/h2]

[*]During the specified period, players can increase their level by completing [b]daily and weekly missions in online matches[/b], allowing them to obtain various items.

[*]In the PREMIUM tier, where items are even more luxurious, players can also acquire [b]TEKKEN COINS[/b], which can be exchanged for various items in the [b]TEKKEN SHOP.[/b]

[h2][b]▼ New items added to the TEKKEN SHOP][/b][/h2]

[*]New costume sets [b]"Cyber Pack 01"[/b] and [b]"Cyber Pack 02"[/b] available for all playable characters.

[*]A legacy costume for [b]Yoshimitsu[/b]

[*][b]EDDY GORDO[/b] Avatar Skin

[h2][b]▼ Functional improvements, Bug fixes.[/b][/h2]

[*]A feature has been added to [b]RANKED MATCH, QUICK MATCH, and GROUP MATCH[/b] modes to allow for the termination and invalidation of matches if the network connection quality falls below certain specified conditions.

[*]An indication has been added to the versus screen in [b]PLAYER MATCH[/b] mode to display when the stage has been randomly selected.

[*]A QUIT option has been added to the [b]MAIN MENU[/b] to allow the game to be exited from sources other than the options menu (Steam version only).
 
[h2][b]▼ Behavior/properties of moves will be adjusted for some characters.[/b][/h2]

[*]In version 1.03, continuing from the previous version 1.02, focus was placed on [b]correcting unintended move behavior[/b].

[*]Work on an update focused on battle system balance is underway, but we are undertaking this with utmost caution by carefully evaluating user play data collected from around the world. [b]Version 1.04 is scheduled for release in May following the conclusion of EVO Japan 2024.[/b]

[*]Version 1.04 will primarily focus on buffing characters who haven't been able to fully showcase their uniqueness. However, adjustments to certain moves that exhibit significant strength will also be made.
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43136267/5be96a3befb3c818ba2d9ea7d126208b23cd3ab1.jpg[/img] 

[h2][b]▼ Scope of Update[/b][/h2]

[*]The application of the update data will result in the following impact on each mode and feature.

[*]“[b]DOWNLOADED REPLAYS[/b]”,”[b]MY REPLAY & TIPS[/b]”: Replay data from before the update will be unavailable for playback.

[*]“[b]ONLINE REPLAY[/b]”: Replay data from before the update will be deleted.

[*][b]“SUPER GHOST BATTLE”,”GHOST MATCH”[/b]: Character behavior and move properties will reflect that of the post-update state.
[/list]

[h2][b]We hope you’ll continue to enjoy TEKKEN 8![/b][/h2]

This premium printing ensures that your mousepad remains as vibrant and sharp as the day you first laid eyes on it.

The [b]Premium Collector’s Edition[/b] of TEKKEN 8 includes the [b]full game[/b], along with [b]unique collectible items[/b] and [b]additional digital content[/b].[/h3]

Enjoy [b]high-fidelity graphics[/b], developed for the new generation of hardware to[b] showcase every moment of impact and aggressive super moves[/b].

With a variety of single-player content to explore, such as the [b]brand-new Arcade Quest mode[/b] and an [b]in-depth customization system[/b] for both playable and avatar characters, TEKKEN 8 introduces [b]the most thrilling experience yet[/b].[/h3]

[*] [b]Arcade Token:[/b] A 5 cm arcade token featuring the iconic Jin VS Kazuya face-off and a cherished keepsake that pays homage to TEKKEN's enduring arcade legacy.
[*] [b]Leroy Smith Metal Ring:[/b] Elevate your style with the Leroy Smith Metal Ring, complete with a luxurious velvet pouch. This finely crafted piece showcases Leroy Smith's unique charm and adds a touch of sophistication to any fan's attire.
[*] [b]Collectible Cards: [/b]Enhance your TEKKEN 8 collection with a set of 8 glossy collectible cards, each featuring stunning artwork and iconic characters - a must-have for both fans and collectors.

[/list]
[h3]But that's not all! Our Premium Collector's Edition also includes [b]a wealth of digital content[/b] to enhance your gaming experience:[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Playable Character Year 1 Pass: [/b]Gain access to 4 additional playable characters, along with the exclusive avatar skin: Kinjin.
[*] [b]Character Costume: Gold Suit Pack[/b] - Dress up your favorite characters with this dazzling costume pack, featuring one unique outfit for each of the 32 playable characters.
[*] [b]Avatar Costume: Classic TEKKEN T-shirt set[/b] - Show your TEKKEN spirit with the 32 different designs for your avatars.
[*] [b]Avatar Skins: Kazuya Mishima, Jin Kazama, and Jun Kazama[/b] - Transform into your favorite TEKKEN characters with these iconic character avatar skins![/list]
[url=https://bnent.eu/TK8PremiumPC][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43136267/ddede80c9e9302ab4b4cc1ee30beb0f5e5dabcef.jpg[/img][/url]

[previewyoutube=jGQBmSsunT4;full][/previewyoutube][i]Watch the first gameplay video and feel the intensity of the fights![/i]

[h3]This latest saga begins where the previous title left off, with a [b]world mired deep in the devastating war [/b]between Kazuya Mishima and Jin Kazama. After suffering what seems to be a defeat from Kazuya, [b]Jin faces his own fate[/b]. His mother, Jun Kazama, appears after her absence from the TEKKEN franchise to try and turn the tide in this blood feud.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43136267/799aa530977566982fe0f529437f7b1bf3032c73.jpg[/img]

Retaining TEKKEN’s unique fighting game identity, the game will [b]provide both players and spectators with the series‘ most thrilling experience[/b] yet with visceral screen-jarring attacks and environments that are both dynamic and destructible.

The trailer highlights[b] an all-new game mechanic called the “Heat System,”[/b] which triggers aggressive attacks with special moves and enhancements for each character’s abilities.

The trailer also showcases [b]the return of favourite characters[/b] such as: [/h3]
